items.name: Semi-synthetic dataset: motor vehicle crashes and temperature in Catalonia
items.description: Semi-synthetic dataset that was created to approximate the relationship between the daily number of motor vehicle crashes and ambient temperature in 14 climatic regions of Catalonia (warm seasons of years 2000-2011)

items.name: Data of the project HHS-EWS (European Research Council Proof-of-Concept Grant No. 101069213)
items.description: Metadata describing the datasets used for the project HHS-EWS (European Research Council Proof-of-Concept Grant No. 101069213). It includes mortality data for several European countries, gridded population data, population data from Eurostat, temperature data, and weather forecasts.

items.name: Vegetation characteristics , soil moisture and biodiversity data from urban green spaces (UGS) in Barcelona (BioWater project)
items.description: This dataset contains ecological data collected in urban green spaces (UGS) in Barcelona within the BioWater project. It includes variables describing vegetation characteristics and biodiversity, and soil moisture and temperature measures
